title: Multi-Target Edge ML Serialization & Streaming Delay-Line Architecture

edges.description: Zero-allocation TFLite, HDF5, SavedModel, and TF.js weight shard header inspection

claims.assertion: Streaming keyword spotting and audio frontends (kws_streaming, non_semantic_speech_benchmark) decouple acoustic frontend feature extraction from neural backbones via dual TFLite FlatBuffer graph exports (model1_wfrontend.tflite at 83 KB vs model1_woutfrontend.tflite at 271 KB) and explicit stateful ring-buffer delay lines.

Cross-platform sequence-tagging models (sign_language_detection) pair Python Keras HDF5 checkpoints (models/py/model.h5, 109,264 B) with browser-executable TensorFlow.js Layers manifests (models/js/model.json + group1-shard1of1.bin, 92,680 B, 23,170 float32 parameters across lstm/lstm_cell and dense heads).

Research monorepo packages decouple hyperparameter injection from core model definitions using declarative Gin configuration graphs (321 .gin files across google-research-master) alongside absl.flags CLI entrypoints.

author: Brain Harness Reflector (harness-reflector)
